_source: Verified from decompiled alarm-notification-common-7.3.9 / alarm-notification-gateway-7.3.9 (com.inductiveautomation.ignition.alarming.common.pipelines.PipelineDescriptor, com.inductiveautomation.ignition.alarming.pipelines.AlarmPipelineManagerImpl) in the decompiled jars, and a live round-trip on a 8.3.9 gateway: a PipelineDescriptor was XML-serialized with the module's own XMLSerializer, written to data/projects/<project>/com.inductiveautomation.alarm-notification/alarm-pipelines/_fm_throwaway/{resource.json,data.bin}, picked up by requestScan() (AlarmPipelineManager.getPipelineNames() -> ['project:<project>:/pipeline:<name>']), then deleted. Nothing here is invented.

onDisk._nestingNote: AlarmPipelineManagerImpl.startPipelineFromResource() uses resource.getFolderPath() as the pipeline name and resource.getCollectionName() as the project name; a name with '/' nests (e.g. 'Area1/Escalation').

notes: scope 'G' accepted and loaded+ran on the gateway (the pipeline executes in gateway scope).
The Designer additionally writes attributes.lastModificationSignature / attributes.lastModification {actor,timestamp}; not required for a hand-built resource.
files MUST list 'data.bin' — that is Resource.DEFAULT_DATA_KEY and the only payload.

data.bin.producedBy: gatewayContext XMLSerializer with the alarm-notification module's configureSerializer() delegates registered; AlarmPipelineManagerImpl reads it back with gatewayContext.createDeserializer().deserialize(bytes), rootObjects().get(0) -> PipelineDescriptor
data.bin.shape: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><objects><o cls="com.inductiveautomation.ignition.alarming.common.pipelines.PipelineDescriptor"><o-c m="setRawValueMap" s="1;java.util.Map">… a HashMap of BasicProperty -> value …</o-c></o></objects>
data.bin._handAuthoringNote: This is Java-object XML with class refs, ctor arg-lists and back-references (<ref>N</ref>). It is not practical to hand-write. Build a PipelineDescriptor on the gateway (module classloader) and serialize it, or edit the pipeline in the Designer. See the reference doc for the worked gateway-script recipe.

enabled.purpose: false -> the manager builds a DisabledPipeline; alarm events routed to it fall straight through (no blocks run).

blocks.purpose: One PropertySet per block. Each MUST carry factoryId + blockId (see blocks.schema.json commonProperties). Order is not significant — edges are by blockId UUID.
blocks._cite: PipelineDescriptor.BLOCKS; addBlock() throws if a block lacks factoryId, auto-assigns blockId if missing

startingBlock.purpose: A holder PropertySet whose 'outputId' (UUID) names the first block to run. If absent/unresolvable the pipeline starts at the synthetic NoOp terminal (i.e. does nothing).
startingBlock._cite: PipelineDescriptor.STARTING_BLOCK; constructor seeds it with an empty BasicPropertySet; manager: 'new SingleThreadAlarmPipeline(… (UUID) startingBlockConfig.getOrElse(OUTPUT_ID, NoOpBlock.BLOCK_ID))'

enumValues.OnAck: event exits the pipeline as soon as it is acknowledged (localized label 'Acknowledged')
enumValues.OnClear: event exits the pipeline as soon as it clears (localized label 'Cleared')
enumValues.OnShelve: event exits the pipeline as soon as it is shelved (localized label 'Shelved')

dropoutConditions.purpose: Pipeline-wide early-exit. Checked by DropoutCondition.drop(conditions,event) in every block's evaluation context and inside NotificationBlock before each user notification. This is how a two-way ACK stops a running escalation.
dropoutConditions.serializedAs: <enumset cls="…DropoutCondition"><enum n="OnAck"/>…</enumset> (member name(), not the localized label)
dropoutConditions._cite: PipelineDescriptor.DROPOUT_CONDITIONS (default EnumSet.allOf); DropoutCondition enum {OnAck,OnClear,OnShelve}; the manager copies this onto every block config at load

fallbackPipeline.purpose: Pipeline name to hand the event to when a block hits an evaluation error (ExpressionBlock / SwitchBlock catch blocks). Empty/null -> the event is dropped and logged.

projectName.purpose: The owning project. Injected onto the descriptor and every block config at load time from resource.getCollectionName(); not something you normally persist by hand.

flowGraph.nodes: each entry of PipelineDescriptor.blocks; identified by its blockId (UUID)
flowGraph.edges: output properties on a block config hold the blockId UUID of the successor: 'outputId' (linear blocks), 'trueOutput'/'falseOutput' (Expression), 'outputId0'..'outputId{N-1}' (Splitter, Switch), '_default_' (Switch catch-all)
flowGraph.danglingEdge: if an output UUID is missing from the block map the block falls through to the synthetic NoOpBlock (AbstractPipelineBlock.getOutputBlock -> map.get(NoOpBlock.BLOCK_ID)); NoOp marks the tracking context complete and destroys it after 15 s. A block with no output set therefore just ends that path of the pipeline.
flowGraph.parallelism: SplitterBlock branches the AlarmEvent (AlarmEventInstance.branch) down every outputId{i} and bumps CommonAlarmProperties.LiveBranchCount.
flowGraph.handoff: JumpBlock destroys the current tracking context and calls AlarmPipelineManager.evaluate(<other pipeline>, event) — a full transfer, not a call/return.

activePipeline.purpose: pipeline run when the alarm becomes active

clearPipeline.purpose: pipeline run when the alarm clears

ackPipeline.purpose: pipeline run when the alarm is acknowledged

defaultPipelineProject.purpose: project used to resolve an unqualified pipeline name on this alarm. A pipeline reference may instead be fully qualified as 'project:<Proj>:/pipeline:<Name>'.

bindingToAnAlarm.note: These are ordinary alarm-config keys (dict entries in a tag's 'alarms' list). Cross-reference skill/references/standards/alarms.md.

notificationProfilesReferenced.role: NotificationBlock.notificationProfiles / .notificationProfile name(s) resolve to gateway-scoped Alarm Notification Profiles (Gateway Config → Alarming → Notification), NOT project resources.

typesInThisModule.EmailNotificationProfileType: two-way capable email — appends an ACK link, and/or polls POP3 for reply-to-ACK (EmailNotificationProfileConfig.twoWay / .twoWayPop3)
typesInThisModule.OneWayNotificationProfileType: send-only email, with its own priority criteria + consolidation settings
typesInThisModule.RemoteNotificationProfileType: delegate to a named profile on another gateway across the gateway network

notificationProfilesReferenced.otherTypes: SMS and voice profiles are contributed by separate add-on modules (e.g. the Twilio module); none were installed on gateway 8.3.9 as observed 2026-09-04.

rosters.resourceType: ignition/roster-config (gateway-scoped config resource; Gateway Config → Alarming → Rosters)
